contents_summary: One-page PDF with Figure S1: post-HBOT axial FLAIR brain MR slices of the four patients with numbered lesion arrowheads and a caption stating no visible macroscopic morphology change after HBOT.

pages.contents: One portrait A4 page headed Supplementary Materials with the journal logo at the upper left and the publisher logo at the upper right. A black-background composite figure shows twelve axial grayscale FLAIR brain MR slices in four rows labelled Pt 1 to Pt 4 in yellow and three columns headed A, B, C in yellow, with numbered red arrowheads (Pt 1 1-10, Pt 2 1-9, Pt 3 1-11, Pt 4 1-7). Below it is the Figure S1 caption: Lesions Morphology after HBOT, FLAIR T2-weighted images, three axial slices at different levels for each Pt, red arrowheads point to lesions, legends and arrowhead numbers as in Figure 1, slight head-positioning differences between sessions, and no visible macroscopic changes in brain morphology in all Pts after HBOT. The footer prints the journal citation, DOI and website.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Patient follow-up MR figure for the four patients after HBOT. The only clinical statement is the caption sentence of no visible macroscopic morphology change after HBOT, which restates the article Results; no values, tables or doses appear. Image pixels (lesion appearance) are not transcribed as typed facts.
limitations: The page prints no license notice; asset-level rights remain unclear and the article license is provenance, not blanket relicensing of this page.
The caption says legends and arrowhead numbers are as in Figure 1 although the numbered lesion arrowheads match article Figure 2.
Document inspection is an AI source review, not physician adjudication or a measurement of clinical accuracy.

transcriptions.text: Figure S1. Lesions Morphology after HBOT. FLAIR T2-weighted images.
In all Pts, brain morphology showed no visible macroscopic changes after HBOT.
